title_tag: 7 Best Family Hotels in Budapest (2026), Priced for 4
meta_description: Family hotels in Budapest compared with real prices for 2 adults and 2 kids: family rooms, suites, kitchenettes and free stays for children, from €116 a night.
author_role: 7 family-friendly hotels compared on the room you get for four, the price for 2 adults and 2 kids, and guest scores
lead: Most hotel prices you see are for two adults. Add two kids and the cheap room disappears, or you end up with two rooms. So every price on this page is for 2 adults and 2 children (aged 6 and 9) in one booking, in the room the hotel offers for a family of four. The best deal is a family room where both kids stay free (that is NH Collection City Center, the #1 pick, €149); others give you a bunk bed, a suite with a living room or connecting rooms. This page gets you to the right one in under a minute.

I compared all 7 on what decides a family stay: what room you get for four, whether kids stay free, the price for the same night, breakfast, guest scores and the walk to the sights, all from each hotel's live listing. Filter by kitchenette, free stay for kids or price below, or scroll straight to the ranking. Planning the days? See things to do in Budapest with kids.

guide.h2: Budapest Family Hotels Side by Side
guide.html:
Prices are for 2 adults and 2 children aged 6 and 9, one night (Wednesday 10 March 2027), in the room each hotel offered for that group. Scores are out of 10.

What the numbers say: a family of four can stay in central Budapest for €138–153 a night with a proper family room: YOU Hotel and NH Collection let both kids stay free. Breakfast for four is included at Hampton, Estilo and Regnum, which changes the maths: Regnum at €116 with breakfast is the cheapest morning here.

• The best family room for the money: #1 NH Collection.
  • Kids who will love a bunk bed: #2 YOU Hotel.
  • Two rooms and breakfast included: #3 Hampton by Hilton.
  • A separate living room: #4 Amberlyn.
  • Steps from the river and the Great Market Hall: #5 Estilo.
  • The cheapest night with breakfast: #7 Regnum.

Want a full kitchen? See the aparthotels in Budapest; several have two-bedroom apartments.

guide.h2: Before You Book: Tips for Families
guide.html:
Enter the kids' ages: prices and "free stay" offers depend on the children's ages, so search with the real ages; the room offered for four can change.

Cots: Estilo, Regnum and The Amberlyn mention cribs on their listings; Estilo can also arrange a changing table on request. Ask the hotel to confirm when you book.

Rainy day: Tropicarium, the zoo and more indoor ideas are in our Budapest with kids guide.

faqs.q: What is the best family hotel in Budapest?
faqs.a: NH Collection Budapest City Center is our #1: a Family Room for 2 adults and 2 children where both kids stay free, from €149 a night, next to Blaha Lujza tér, with kitchenettes in the rooms.

faqs.q: How much is a hotel for a family of four in Budapest?
faqs.a: From €116 (Hotel Regnum Residence, breakfast included) to €207 (Hampton by Hilton, two rooms with breakfast) for 2 adults and 2 children on a March weeknight.

faqs.q: Which Budapest hotels let children stay free?
faqs.a: For 10 March 2027, NH Collection City Center and YOU Hotel Budapest offered a free stay for both children; Hampton by Hilton, The Amberlyn and Mövenpick offered it for one child.

faqs.q: Which family hotel in Budapest includes breakfast?
faqs.a: Hampton by Hilton Budapest City Centre, Estilo Hotel and Hotel Regnum Residence included breakfast for all four in the family rate we compared.

faqs.q: Where should families stay in Budapest?
faqs.a: Central Pest (Districts V–VIII) puts you near the metro and most sights. Regnum Residence on the Buda side is close to Margaret Island, a car-free park in the river.

faqs.q: Are there hotels in Budapest with a bunk bed?
faqs.a: YOU Hotel Budapest has a Deluxe Room with one double bed and one bunk bed, where both children stayed free on our date.

methodology: We searched Budapest hotels for 2 adults and 2 children aged 6 and 9 and compared them on what decides a family stay: the room offered for four, free stays for children, the price for the same night (10 March 2027), breakfast, guest scores, cots and the location, all from each hotel's live listing.
